name: Yumi-MD
description: An ultra-fast, feature-rich WhatsApp Multi-Device bot built with Node.js and Baileys.

OWNER_NAME.description: Your name (will be displayed on the vCard and owner command)

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Primary owner WhatsApp phone number in international format without + (e.g. 919876543210)

MODS.description: Phone numbers of users who you want to be bot moderators/admins separated by comma (e.g. 919876543210,919123456780)

MONGODB_URI.description: A valid MongoDB connection URI string for database persistence

SESSION_FOLDER.description: Name of the directory to store session credentials

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Google API key for custom search (optional)

INTERAPI_KEY.description: API key for InterAPI social media downloader (Facebook, etc.)
